groups.defect: The join deadline breaks out of the worker loop, skipping cleanup of remaining workers.
groups.rationale: All three identify the same premature break at lines 338–341 and require cleanup to continue for every worker after the waiting deadline expires.

groups.defect: The process type guard skips killing hung spawn workers before starting their replacements.
groups.rationale: All three identify the same incompatible isinstance check at lines 254–255, which leaves the original worker alive while its handle is overwritten by a replacement.
